observation.visible_scene: Interior of a stone/brick fireplace. A large bark-covered log lies horizontally on a black metal grate/andiron. Glowing red embers and low flames sit under and around the log; a rolled piece of paper burns with a small flame at the front bottom-right, and a taller flame rises from behind the right portion of the log.
visible_changes: The tall flame behind the right side of the log continuously flickers, growing tall and narrow in some frames (e.g., 1, 3, 6, 13, 19, 22) and shrinking or nearly vanishing in others (e.g., 8, 11, 12, 15, 16, 20, 21).
The flame on the rolled paper at the front right flickers in height and brightness throughout the excerpt.
The bed of red embers beneath the log glows and shifts slightly in intensity.
A brief whole-frame blur appears around frames 24-25 and clears by frames 26-27, consistent with a momentary camera shake or focus change rather than object movement.
The log, grate posts, paper, and brick walls hold fixed positions; no translation, rotation, or deformation of solid objects is observed.
outside_clip_unknowns: The stage of the burn before the crop and any later outcome (e.g., whether the log shifts or collapses) are not shown.
The cause of the brief blur (camera handling vs. focus) cannot be confirmed from the frames alone.
uncertain_details: The physical cause of the flame-height variations (airflow/draft) is not directly observable.
Whether the blur is camera motion or motion blur is uncertain due to limited background cues.
